heading: WHY SAVVY MEDIA BUYERS ARE BETTING ON MALL ADVERTISING (4 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Media buyers are increasingly turning to mall advertising because it delivers something scarce in a fragmented media landscape: physically present and highly attentive audiences rather than sheer digital reach. Malls have shifted from pure retail destinations into lifestyle hubs, drawing people in for fitness classes and healthcare appointments as often as for shopping. That inventory is now largely digitized, so buyers can target every screen within a set distance of a specific location and measure results through foot traffic, offsite visits, and spend data instead of modeled estimates.

heading: INSIDE GENERAL MILLS'S BRAND ARCHIVE (4 MINUTE READ)
blurb: General Mills's brand archive functions as both a lookup service and a forward-looking curation system, holding more than 10,000 records across 5,000 square feet that trace the company's 160-year history. Brand teams query it for context on products like Bisquick and Betty Crocker, while the three-person team also flags today's campaigns as candidates for tomorrow's collection. The volume and variety of modern marketing content, spanning far more channels than earlier decades, has made deciding what to keep the hardest ongoing call.
